allowed_inputs: factory namespace, UUID, repository, and budget allocations
committed pack-local tooling foundation created before reproduction
source-neutral functional tests and asset workload contract
prohibited_inputs: the preliminary implementation tree or package bytes
Java artifacts, decompiled text, Java identifiers, or source assets
private oracle material or hidden cases
SSH, Studio, remote-shell, or credential material
reproduction_authority.content_rule: Recreate the accepted source-neutral product scope without reading or importing the preliminary implementation. Byte equivalence to the preliminary package is not required and does not prove authorship isolation.
reproduction_authority.receipt_rule: The actual reproducing process must produce a contemporaneous candidate-bound isolation receipt and independent noncircular validation under FCPA-T01-V1-0001.

reason: The preliminary implementation predates contemporaneous candidate-bound process evidence. A later deterministic rebuild cannot retroactively prove isolated authorship.
next_action: The existing durable pack owner may create the allocated fresh repository and reproduce the same accepted source-neutral scope. The preserved preliminary repository remains read-only reference history and may not be read by the reproduction process.
